name: USB2
PCI0
body:
Name (_HID, "PNP0A08")
      Name (_CID, "PNP0A03")
      Name (_UID, 0)
      Name (_SEG, 0)
      Name (_BBN, 0x00)
      Name (_CCA, 0)
      Name (_CRS, ResourceTemplate () {
        WordBusNumber (
          ResourceProducer, MinFixed, MaxFixed, PosDecode,
          0x0,
          0x00,
          0xff,
          0x00,
          0x100
        )
        QWordMemory (
          ResourceProducer, PosDecode, MinFixed, MaxFixed,
          NonCacheable, ReadWrite,
          0x00000000,
          0x0010000000,
          0x007FFFFFFF,
          0x1100000000,
          0x0070000000
        )
        QWordMemory (
          ResourceProducer, PosDecode, MinFixed, MaxFixed,
          Prefetchable, ReadWrite,
          0x0,
          0x0000001800000000,
          0x00000018FFFFFFFF,
          0x0000000000000000,
          0x0000000100000000
        )
      })
      Name (SUPP, 0)
      Name (CTRL, 0)
      Method (_OSC, 4, NotSerialized)
      {
        CreateDWordField (Arg3, 0, CDW1)
        If (Arg0 == ToUUID ("33DB4D5B-1FF7-401C-9657-7441C03DD766"))
        {
          CreateDWordField (Arg3, 4, CDW2)
          CreateDWordField (Arg3, 8, CDW3)
          SUPP = CDW2 & 0x10
          CTRL = CDW3 & 0x10
          If (Arg1 != 1) { CDW1 |= 0x08 }
          If (CDW3 != CTRL) { CDW1 |= 0x10 }
          CDW3 = CTRL
          Return (Arg3)
        }
        CDW1 |= 0x04
        Return (Arg3)
      }
